answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the trellis of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The glacier of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
